name: volens
description: Keeps a project's documentation in step with its decisions: an append-only decision log, a design snapshot derived from it, and a hook that keeps the snapshot fresh without being asked.

interface.shortDescription: Project docs that follow your decisions
interface.longDescription: volens maintains three layers of project documentation — a marker-delimited contract module in the project's instruction file, an append-only decision log, and a design snapshot derived from it — and keeps that snapshot fresh automatically as decisions change.
defaultPrompt: Set up the volens documentation structure in this project.
Record a design decision in the decision log.
